meta_description:
131K likes, 6,340 comments - joerogan on February 14, 2024: "My @Spotify playlist “Green Room” is available to everyone.  It’s currently over 18 hours long, and it features a pretty wide variety of artists; everything from @garyclarkjr to Nina Simone, to @jellyroll615 to Lynyrd Skynyrd to Janis Joplin and @wutangclan. 
New shit gets added to it all the time, and it’s the actual playlist we use in the @comedymothership green room.".
